tagline: Review copy edits word by word, with a claims check first
use_when: You have copy-edit feedback for an article or page and want to approve each change yourself, with risky claims flagged, before anything touches the file.
try_it: Use the article-copy-edit skill to review these suggested edits to my pricing page before you apply any of them.

features.label: Risky Claims, Checked First
features.sub: A claims check is always the first section
features.title: A claims check is always the first section
features.what: Before your own feedback is touched, the whole page is read for claims that could get you in trouble, and the findings appear first. It runs every time, even when your feedback says nothing about claims.
features.html:
1Claims check
2
3

features.label: What's Risky in Your Field?
features.sub: Claude asks which claims are risky in your line of work
features.title: Claude asks which claims are risky in your line of work
features.what: Risky claims depend on the business: health and wellness sites, product-safety claims, financial results and so on each have their own. Claude looks in your project notes, asks once if they don't say, and keeps the answer in the notes so it does not ask again. It checks for those claims on top of the general list.
features.html:
What claims are risky in your field?
supplements: no cure or treatment claims

features.label: The Usual Suspects
features.sub: Guarantees, cure claims, results without a caveat, risky headlines
features.title: Guarantees, cure claims, results without a caveat, risky headlines
features.what: The check always looks for guarantee language, claims to diagnose or cure, results or testimonials with no "results vary" note, and headlines that read as a claim on their own, since titles end up in tabs, search results and link previews.
features.html:
guaranteed resultsRisky
Cures back painRisky
Results vary by personSafe

features.label: Missing Affiliate Disclosures
features.sub: Pages with affiliate links but no disclosure get flagged
features.title: Pages with affiliate links but no disclosure get flagged
features.what: If a page recommends products through affiliate links without the disclosure the FTC requires, it is flagged, even when fixing it is outside this review.
features.html:
Product picksNo disclosure
Affiliate links found, but no "we may earn a commission" note.

features.label: A Clean Check Still Shows
features.sub: No findings is shown as a passed check, not a missing section
features.title: No findings is shown as a passed check, not a missing section
features.what: When nothing is found, the section still appears and says no concerns were found in this pass. You can see the check happened rather than wondering whether it was skipped.
features.html:
1 · Claims checkPassed
No claims concerns found in this pass.

features.label: The Exact Words
features.sub: Before and after show the real text, never a summary
features.title: Before and after show the real text, never a summary
features.what: The Original and Edit panes always hold the exact sentence a reader would see, written out in full even when the feedback only described the change. You decide on real copy.

features.label: See Exactly What Changed
features.sub: Changed words are highlighted inside the sentence
features.title: Changed words are highlighted inside the sentence
features.what: Inside each pair, only the words that changed are marked, so a one-word fix in a long paragraph is easy to spot.
features.html: Try it for free free for 14 days, no card needed.

features.label: Looks Like Your Page
features.sub: Uses your page's own type and before/after colors
features.title: Uses your page's own type and before/after colors
features.what: The review page borrows the real page's fonts and colors, including any before/after colors your site already uses, and works in light and dark mode. The edits read the way they will on the site.

features.label: Three Sections, Fixed Order
features.sub: Claims check, then copy edits, then additions
features.title: Claims check, then copy edits, then additions
features.what: Items are grouped as Claims check, Copy Edits, and Additions and Recommendations, always in that order, each item numbered.

features.sub: Proposed additions show what's there now and where they'd go
features.title: Proposed additions show what's there now and where they'd go
features.what: A suggested new section or call to action shows what's there today, usually nothing, next to the proposed text and where on the page it would go.

features.sub: Competing options each note that picking one replaces the other
features.title: Competing options each note that picking one replaces the other

features.label: Behind-the-Scenes Text Too
features.sub: Alt text and meta tags shown as code
features.title: Alt text and meta tags shown as code
features.what: Changes readers don't see directly, like image alt text or page descriptions, still get a card, shown as before and after code snippets.

features.label: An Honest Opinion
features.sub: Every item has a reason and a recommendation
features.title: Every item has a reason and a recommendation
features.what: Each item says why the change is proposed and carries a Recommended or Not Recommended badge. Items Claude has doubts about are still shown, marked Not Recommended with the reason, so you can overrule it.

features.label: Four Clear Choices
features.sub: Keep, use, approve with a comment, or ask for another try
features.title: Keep, use, approve with a comment, or ask for another try
features.what: Each item has Keep Original, Use Edit, Approve with Comment and Request Revision. Every item starts undecided, and only one choice can be active.
